## About
European Import Specialists is an independent repair shop in Marietta, just north of downtown Atlanta near Dobbins Air Reserve Base. We work on German cars: BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Audi, Volkswagen and Mini Cooper.
The shop is run by owner Kellie Cox, with factory trained mechanics in the back. Whether you need a routine oil service or a major repair, we take each job seriously no matter how big or small.
While you wait, there is free wifi and fresh coffee. If you want a second opinion before going back to the dealer, give us a call.

## Services
- Oil service: Routine oil service to keep your engine running smoothly.
- Scheduled maintenance: We handle the scheduled maintenance your German car calls for.
- Brakes: Brake work on European cars. One reviewer brought in a Porsche Macan for new brakes.
- AC and radiator care: Keeping your AC and radiator working properly.
- Purchase inspection: We look the car over and give you a detailed report with prices and recommendations.
- Road trip inspection: A thorough look at your car before the family heads out on a trip.

## FAQ
Q: Which makes do you work on?
A: BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Mini Cooper, Audi and Volkswagen.

Q: Where are you located?
A: In Marietta, about 15 minutes north of downtown Atlanta near Dobbins Air Reserve Base.

Q: What if my car can't be driven in?
A: Our preferred towing service is Patriot Towing Company, and our preferred car rental is Enterprise Rent A Car.
